The ultimate Seoul itinerary\ud83d\udc47\ud83c\udffc \ud83c\uddf0\ud83c\uddf7\ud83c\udf5c

We spent 4 days exploring Seoul on our 2-week South Korea trip and made the mistake so you don’t have to!

Here’s exactly how we’d spend 4 days as first-timers without wasting time (or money!!)

(New here? Follow us @aidenandmaddy for episode 4 - the best food spots in Seoul)

4 day Seoul itinerary overview:

\ud83c\udf75 Day 1

• Ikseon-dong Hanok Village (try Salt Bread, Cheonsudang Bakery or Soha Salt Pond)
• Shopping streets of Insadong
• Changdeokgung Palace
• Sunset at N Seoul Tower (walk or take the cable car)
• Dinner at Myeongdong Kyoja (Michelin Guide) + the night market

\ud83c\udf8e Day 2

• Gyeongbokgung Palace for the changing of the guard (10 am \u0026 2 pm)
• Bukchon Hanok Village (10 am - 5 pm)
• Gwangjang Market

\ud83d\udeb6 Day 3
• Seoul City Wall walk
• Dongdaemun Design Plaza (free)
• Hongdae
• Gyeongui Line Forest Park

\ud83d\udecd️ Day 4

• Onion café
• Starfield Library
• Gangnam Style hands
• Shopping

Part 1 of everything we ate in Korea, starting with a few very memorable meals in Seoul. Save for your next trip \ud83d\ude0b\ud83c\uddf0\ud83c\uddf7 foodie ig: smeli.beli

˖ ࣪⭑ Gangnam Myeonok: we stumbled upon this restaurant after our flight and a long commute to our airbnb in sinsadong. it hit the spot and I can't believe this wasn't originally on the itinerary! highly rec the galbi jjim (tender braised beef short ribs) and cold naengmyeon noodles

˖ ࣪⭑ Solsot: with 10+ pot rice flavor options, it was hard to choose but we both decided on the steak sotbap. the set was filling and came with a mini yakult drink

˖ ࣪⭑ Oreno Ramen: michelin bib gourmand for 8 years in a row! chicken tori paitan ramen with a super creamy broth. unlimited noodle/rice/broth refills for ~$11 usd... affordable \u0026 tasty! only two ramen options on the menu so it's perfect if you're indecisive ;) one of our final meals of the trip and one of the best

✅ 5 places to eat near Andaz I recommend: 

1. Apgujeong Miyeok
    \ud83d\udccd102, 17 Apgujeong-ro 30-gil, Gangnam-gu, Seoul

Only a less than a two-minute walk from Andaz. They specialize in Korean seaweed soup, with options like flounder, abalone, sea urchin, and beef. Most soups are around $7–$15. I ordered Special Octopus Abalone Soup and it was the best miyeok guk I’ve ever had in my entire life. 

2. Jikang Korean Restaurant – Apgujeong Main Branch
    \ud83d\udccd104-1, 111 \u0026 112, 17 Apgujeong-ro 30-gil, Gangnam-gu, Seoul

Like I mentioned, I never tried it but according to Naver (Korean Google) reviews are great so I’ll definitely go check it out. If you never tried Nak-Gop-Sae, you should try it (if you like seafood and gopchang). But in the video, we got Nak-Woo-Sae (baby octopus, beef belly, shrimp). It’s a really delicious dish that you should try. And this restaurant is a two-minute walk from Andaz. 

3. Chinese Guesthouse Soo – Apgujeong Branch                                                                                                                                                                                                                               \ud83d\udccd64 Nonhyeon-ro 175-gil, Gangnam-gu, Seoul                                                                                                                                                                                                                            7-10 min walk from Andaz. Their jjajanmyeon and tang-su-yuk (sweet and sour fried pork) were insanely good.

4. Jeju Rooftop Black BBQ – Apgujeong
    \ud83d\udccd34 Eonju-ro 170-gil, Gangnam-gu, Seoul

About 12-15 min walk from Andaz. Their signature Black BBQ course comes with assorted aged Jeju black pork, including pork belly, shoulder, and specialty cuts. It’s around $28 per person. The restaurant’s dramatic cave-inspired interior makes it feel like you’re eating inside Jeju’s volcanic landscape. It’s famous so you’ll see a lot of foreigners.

5. Hyundai Department Store – Apgujeong Main Branch
    \ud83d\udccd165 Apgujeong-ro, Gangnam-gu, Seoul

You’ll see so many options to eat there. Only 3-5 min walk from Andaz and directly connected to Apgujeong Station.

Also, the bottom floor connected to the subway station has tons of restaurants. I haven’t tried them, but I’ve heard they’re good too. #korea #tiktokfood

Seoul Al-Gopchang Grilled over Briquette Charcoal in the Traditional Way for 25 Years

\ud83d\udccdYesanjip Gopchang (예산집곱창)
(Address: 34 Jongro 40ga-gil, Jongno-gu, Seoul)

\ud83d\udd17Google Maps Link: https://maps.app.goo.gl/vHHFj5Z3YmkgbUQN7

\ud83d\udd25Al-Gopchang (Stir-fried Tripe): 12,000 KRW per serving

⏰Hours: 11:30 AM - 10:00 PM / Closed on the 1st, 3rd, and 5th Sundays of every month

This is 'Yesanjip Gopchang,' located in the Dongdaemun Gopchang Alley in Seoul, which has stuck to the traditional way of grilling over briquette charcoal for over 20 years.

This place grills the gopchang thoroughly over a briquette fire, so there is absolutely no gamey smell, and it features a deep, subtle smoky flavor.

I ordered the Al-gopchang, which is cleanly stir-fried with just veggies and tripe. Pairing it with a refreshing glass of Somaek (beer and soju mix) was truly an incredible combination!

With the nice and cool weather these days, I highly recommend visiting this place to enjoy some bouncy, spicy gopchang as a snack and have a drink!\ud83c\udf7b\ud83d\udd25

Did you know Jersey Village is packed with amazing places to eat?

The 3rd Annual Jersey Village Restaurant Week is happening September 7-21, and I was so excited to see Seoulside Korean Street Eats on the participating restaurant list!

For $26 you get 6 bone in and 6 boneless wings with 4 flavors you can choose from, 2 sides, and 2 drinks.

I love their honey butter flavor – it’s crispy, savory, slightly sweet, and completely addictive.

Check out the Jersey Village Restaurant Week deals – you don’t want to miss out!

#JerseyVillageRestaurantWeek #HoustonFoodie #SupportLocal #KoreanFriedChicken

Found the ultimate dinner spot in the heart of Myeongdong — Taecho Galbi (태초갈비)! \ud83e\udd69✨
@태초갈비 명동점(Taecho_myeongdong) 

From the dramatic tableside fire show to the melt-in-your-mouth marbled beef, every single detail here is pure perfection. The staff grills everything right in front of you so you can just sit back, enjoy the incredible flavors, and indulge in their massive, hearty portions.
An absolute must-visit if you’re looking for an unforgettable K-BBQ experience in Seoul!
